name: Used Tool Inspection
query:
SELECT UT.name AS "Document No:Link/TMS Used Tool Inspection",
UT.posting_date AS "Date:Date",
UT.customer AS "Customer:Link/Customer",
UT.customer_name AS "Customer Name",
UT.branch AS "Branch",
UTI.item_code AS "Item Code:Link/Item",
UTI.item_name AS "Item Name",
UTI.qty AS "Qty",
UTI.physical_tool_code AS "Physical Tool Code",
UTI.tms_tool_registration AS "Tool Registration",
UTI.disposition AS "Disposition",
UTI.inspection_result AS "Inspection Result",
UTI.tool_type AS "Tool Type",
TC.condition_name AS "Condition"

From `tabTMS Used Tool Inspection` UT
Inner Join  `tabTMS Used Tool Inspection Item` UTI on UTI.parent = UT.name

LEFT JOIN `tabTMS Tool Condition` TC
    ON TC.name = UTI.tool_condition

WHERE UT.posting_date BETWEEN %(from_date)s AND %(to_date)s
